<div class="hs_cos_wrapper hs_cos_wrapper_widget hs_cos_wrapper_type_module" data-hs-cos-general-type="widget" data-hs-cos-type="module" id="hs_cos_wrapper_widget_1561535135390" style=""><!-- this module cannot be used at same time as refresh 2019 - notification bottom left -->
<div class="u-text-center">
<div class="o-notification o-notification--left">
<ul>
<li><a class="js-modal-btn" data-target="c-modal--cqc" href="#"><img alt="cqc regulated" aria-hidden="true" height="20" src="https://www.pushdoctor.co.uk/hubfs/refresh/icons/icon-verified.svg" width="20"/>CQC regulated</a></li>
<li><a class="js-modal-btn" data-target="c-modal--secure-payment" href="#"><img alt="secure payment" aria-hidden="true" height="20" src="https://www.pushdoctor.co.uk/hubfs/refresh/icons/icon-lock.svg" width="20"/>Secure data</a></li>
<li><a class="js-modal-btn" data-target="c-modal--medicines" href="#"><img alt="authorised medicine seller" aria-hidden="true" height="20" src="https://www.pushdoctor.co.uk/hubfs/refresh/icons/icon-medicine.svg" width="20"/>Authorised medicines seller</a></li>
<li><a class="js-modal-btn" data-target="c-modal--gmc" href="#"><img alt="gmc-registered GPs" aria-hidden="true" height="20" src="https://www.pushdoctor.co.uk/hubfs/refresh/icons/icon-stethoscope.svg" width="20"/>GMC-registered GPs</a></li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<div aria-expanded="false" class="c-modal c-modal--cqc">
<div class="c-modal__wrap u-pt24@xs" role="dialog" style="padding: 0;">
<div class="mdc-layout-grid mdc-layout-grid--no-margin-bottom">
<div class="mdc-layout-grid__inner mdc-layout-grid__inner--is-visible">
<div class="mdc-layout-grid__cell">
<h2><img alt="cqc regulated" aria-hidden="true" height="40" src="https://www.pushdoctor.co.uk/hubfs/refresh/icons/icon-verified.svg" style="vertical-align: text-bottom;" width="40"/> CQC regulated</h2>
<p>Push Doctor is regulated by the Care Quality Commission (CQC), the independent regulator of health and social care in England.</p>
<p>They are the foremost authority in our industry, assessing health providers' ability to provide people with safe, effective, compassionate and high-quality care – be they offline or online doctors.</p>
<p>Push Doctor is registered with the CQC under the name 'Push Dr Limited', with the registration number <a href="https://www.cqc.org.uk/location/1-5345986073" tabindex="-1" target="_blank">1-5345986073</a>.</p>
<p>Our most recent inspection took place in May 2019, concluding that the service we provide is safe, effective, caring, responsive and well-led – gaining a 'Good' rating overall. You can read the report in full on <a href="https://www.cqc.org.uk/location/1-5345986073" tabindex="-1" target="_blank">our CQC profile</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<button class="c-modal__close-btn" tabindex="-1">Close <i class="material-icons">cancel</i></button>
</div>
</div>
<div aria-expanded="false" class="c-modal c-modal--secure-payment">
<div class="c-modal__wrap u-pt24@xs" role="dialog" style="padding: 0;">
<div class="mdc-layout-grid mdc-layout-grid--no-margin-bottom">
<div class="mdc-layout-grid__inner mdc-layout-grid__inner--is-visible">
<div class="mdc-layout-grid__cell">
<h2><img alt="secure payment" aria-hidden="true" height="40" src="https://www.pushdoctor.co.uk/hubfs/refresh/icons/icon-lock.svg" style="vertical-align: text-bottom;" width="40"/>Secure data</h2>
<p>Push Doctor uses the latest technologies to ensure utmost security. We utilise several layers of firewall security and encrypt all personal data to ensure it’s safe.</p>
<p>All users are required to go through a two-step verification process to create and restore an account. Online access to an account is protected with a password that a user creates and PD apps support touch ID technology.</p>
<p>When using the platform, all personal data is transmitted through the internet using secure socket Layers (SSL) technology. SSL technology causes a browser to encrypt entered information before transmitting it to our secure server. SSL technology, an industry standard, is designed to prevent a third party from capturing and viewing Personal Data.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<button class="c-modal__close-btn" tabindex="-1">Close <i class="material-icons">cancel</i></button>
</div>
</div>
<div aria-expanded="false" class="c-modal c-modal--medicines">
<div class="c-modal__wrap u-pt24@xs" role="dialog" style="padding: 0;">
<div class="mdc-layout-grid mdc-layout-grid--no-margin-bottom">
<div class="mdc-layout-grid__inner mdc-layout-grid__inner--is-visible">
<div class="mdc-layout-grid__cell">
<h2><img alt="authorised medicine seller" aria-hidden="true" height="40" src="https://www.pushdoctor.co.uk/hubfs/refresh/icons/icon-medicine.svg" style="vertical-align: text-bottom;" width="40"/> Authorised medicines seller</h2>
<p>Push Doctor is registered with the <a href="https://medicine-seller-register.mhra.gov.uk/" tabindex="-1" target="_blank">Medicines &amp; Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA)</a>, and fully approved to sell medicines from our website.</p>
<p>We have been approved sellers since our inception, with the company number of <a href="https://medicine-seller-register.mhra.gov.uk/search-registry/422" tabindex="-1" target="_blank">C46132</a>. As authorised MHRA sellers, we are approved to sell the following as and when we need to do so:</p>
<ul>
<li>Prescription only medicines</li>
<li>General sales list medicines</li>
<li>Pharmacy medicines</li>
</ul>
<p>We regularly review the medications that we prescribe on our service, making sure to meet best practice and only ever provide outstanding care. With this, and our <a href="https://www.cqc.org.uk/location/1-5345986073" tabindex="-1" target="_blank">CQC rating</a>, you know you are in safe hands.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<button class="c-modal__close-btn" tabindex="-1">Close <i class="material-icons">cancel</i></button>
</div>
</div>
<div aria-expanded="false" class="c-modal c-modal--gmc">
<div class="c-modal__wrap u-pt24@xs" role="dialog" style="padding: 0;">
<div class="mdc-layout-grid mdc-layout-grid--no-margin-bottom">
<div class="mdc-layout-grid__inner mdc-layout-grid__inner--is-visible">
<div class="mdc-layout-grid__cell">
<h2><img alt="gmc-registered GPs" aria-hidden="true" height="40" src="https://www.pushdoctor.co.uk/hubfs/refresh/icons/icon-stethoscope.svg" style="vertical-align: text-bottom;" width="40"/> GMC-registered GPs</h2>
<p>All of our doctors are NHS-trained and registered with the General Medical Council (GMC), ensuring that you are only ever receiving the best possible care and advice.</p>
<p>We encourage you to <a href="/meet-our-doctors" tabindex="-1">familiarise yourself with our online doctors</a>, check their GMC profiles for yourself – every doctor on our platform has one, which you can easily <a href="https://webcache.gmc-uk.org/gmclrmp_enu/start.swe" tabindex="-1">search the GMC's database</a> for.</p>
<p>In the majority of cases, we even give a direct link to our doctors' LinkedIn pages so you can see where they have worked in the past and where they were educated.</p>
<p>You can also see who our <a href="/meet-our-medical-support-team" tabindex="-1">medical support</a> and <a href="/meet-our-medical-team" tabindex="-1">data protection teams</a> are as well.</p>
<p>We welcome scrutiny, and encourage you to <a href="/contact" tabindex="-1">get in touch</a> if you have any questions, concerns or comments about the people that power Push Doctor.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<button class="c-modal__close-btn" tabindex="-1">Close <i class="material-icons">cancel</i></button>
</div>
</div></div>

<h2 class="u-text-center u-mb56@xs u-mb80@lg">How does it work?</h2>
<div class="mdc-layout-grid__inner u-text-center u-text-left@md">
<div class="u-mb24@xs u-mb0@md mdc-layout-grid__cell mdc-layout-grid__cell--span-6-sm mdc-layout-grid__cell--start-2-sm mdc-layout-grid__cell--span-5-md mdc-layout-grid__cell--start-2-md mdc-layout-grid__cell--span-3-lg">
<p class="u-text-primary u-font-style-massive u-font-weight-light">1</p>
<h3 class="u-font-style-h4">Create an account</h3>
<p>Sign up for a Push Doctor account in minutes, either on our website or by downloading our app.</p>
</div>
<div class="u-mb24@xs u-mb0@md mdc-layout-grid__cell mdc-layout-grid__cell--span-6-sm mdc-layout-grid__cell--start-2-sm mdc-layout-grid__cell--span-5-md mdc-layout-grid__cell--start-7-md mdc-layout-grid__cell--span-3-lg">
<p class="u-text-primary u-font-style-massive u-font-weight-light">2</p>
<h3 class="u-font-style-h4">Book an appointment</h3>
<p>See a doctor the same day, at a time and place to suit you – even if it's a weekend or bank holiday.</p>
</div>
<div class="u-mb24@xs u-mb0@md mdc-layout-grid__cell mdc-layout-grid__cell--span-6-sm mdc-layout-grid__cell--start-2-sm mdc-layout-grid__cell--span-5-md mdc-layout-grid__cell--start-2-md mdc-layout-grid__cell--span-3-lg">
<p class="u-text-primary u-font-style-massive u-font-weight-light">3</p>
<h3 class="u-font-style-h4">See a doctor online</h3>
<p>Speak to a GMC-registered doctor by video or text chat, whichever is easiest for you.</p>
</div>
<div class="u-mb24@xs u-mb0@md mdc-layout-grid__cell mdc-layout-grid__cell--span-6-sm mdc-layout-grid__cell--start-2-sm mdc-layout-grid__cell--span-5-md mdc-layout-grid__cell--start-7-md mdc-layout-grid__cell--span-3-lg">

<div class="hs_cos_wrapper hs_cos_wrapper_widget hs_cos_wrapper_type_module" data-hs-cos-general-type="widget" data-hs-cos-type="module" id="hs_cos_wrapper_widget_1560783701672" style="">
<div class="mdc-layout-grid mdc-layout-grid--no-margin-bottom">
<div class="mdc-layout-grid__inner">
<div class="mdc-layout-grid__cell u-text-center">
<h2>Why use an online doctor?</h2>
<p class="subtitle">Join thousands of patients receiving medical advice, prescriptions, referral letters and sick notes through Push Doctor. Our online GPs can treat almost anything that traditional GPs can – minus the waiting, or travelling</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mdc-layout-grid">
<div class="mdc-layout-grid__inner">
<div class="mdc-layout-grid__cell mdc-layout-grid__cell--span-6-md mdc-layout-grid__cell--span-4-lg">
<div class="mdc-card mdc-card--border-left mdc-card--150-md">
<h3 class="u-font-style-p u-font-weight-normal">Doctors on demand</h3>
<p>Talk to an online doctor whenever you want in the UK. All you need is a smartphone, tablet or laptop. <br/> <a href="/meet-our-doctors">Meet the doctors</a></p>
</div>
<div class="mdc-card mdc-card--border-left mdc-card--150-md">
<h3 class="u-font-style-p u-font-weight-normal">Prescriptions in minutes</h3>
<p>A prescription will arrive at your designated pharmacy an hour after your appointment is over.<br/> <a href="/how-it-works/prescriptions">Learn more</a></p>
</div>
<div class="mdc-card mdc-card--border-left mdc-card--150-md u-mb0@xs">
<h3 class="u-font-style-p u-font-weight-normal">Referrals and sick notes</h3>
<p>Whatever treatment we think is best, we will do everything we can to start you on that path.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="u-display-none@xs u-display-inline-block@lg mdc-layout-grid__cell--span-4-lg u-text-center">

<div class="mdc-card mdc-card--border-left mdc-card--150-md">
<h3 class="u-font-style-p u-font-weight-normal">CQC regulated</h3>
<p>Working closely with the Care Quality Commission to maintain a leading standard of care.<br/> <a href="/cqc">Learn more</a></p>
</div>
<div class="mdc-card mdc-card--border-left mdc-card--150-md">
<h3 class="u-font-style-p u-font-weight-normal">Shared health records</h3>
<p>By agreeing to share your records, notes made by your online doctor will be available to your local GP.</p>
</div>
<div class="mdc-card mdc-card--border-left mdc-card--150-md u-mb0@xs">
<h3 class="u-font-style-p u-font-weight-normal">Trusted by you</h3>

</div>

<div class="hs_cos_wrapper hs_cos_wrapper_widget hs_cos_wrapper_type_module" data-hs-cos-general-type="widget" data-hs-cos-type="module" id="hs_cos_wrapper_widget_1559232374348" style=""><div class="mdc-layout-grid">
<div class="mdc-layout-grid__inner">
<div class="mdc-layout-grid__cell mdc-layout-grid__cell--span-6-lg">
<h2>Want to know more about our service?</h2>
</div>
<div class="mdc-layout-grid__cell mdc-layout-grid__cell--span-6-lg">
<div class="c-accordion c-accordion--large-spacing" id="accordion-8">
<h2 class="c-accordion__title"><button aria-controls="accordion-accordion-8-collapsible-8" aria-expanded="false" class="c-accordion__toggle">
                     What happens in the online video consultation?
                </button></h2>
<div aria-hidden="true" class="c-accordion__panel" id="accordion-accordion-8-collapsible-8">
<p>Just like in a physical consultation, the online doctor will discuss your symptoms. As it's a video consultation, they can also take a look at any affected areas, or listen out for symptoms. Where medication is needed for you to get better, the GP can issue a prescription.</p>
</div>
<h2 class="c-accordion__title"><button aria-controls="accordion-accordion-8-collapsible-9" aria-expanded="false" class="c-accordion__toggle">
                     How do I get a prescription?
                </button></h2>
<div aria-hidden="true" class="c-accordion__panel" id="accordion-accordion-8-collapsible-9">
<b>See a GP online in minutes<b><p>Create an account or sign into your existing account, then book an appointment on a day and time to suit you.</p><b>Get the help and advice you need</b><p>Ask all of the questions on your mind, and if appropriate, your GP will prescribe medication during your consultation.</p><b>Pick up from your local pharmacy</b><p>Collect your prescription and medication from your designated pharmacy the very same day, sometimes even within the hour.</p>
</b></b></div><b><b>
<h2 class="c-accordion__title"><button aria-controls="accordion-accordion-8-collapsible-10" aria-expanded="false" class="c-accordion__toggle">
                     What do I need to do at the pharmacy?
                </button></h2>
<div aria-hidden="true" class="c-accordion__panel" id="accordion-accordion-8-collapsible-10">
<p>Let the pharmacist know you’re picking up a private prescription from Push Doctor.<br/><br/>As your prescription has been issued privately, you’ll need to pay for your medication. However, this cost is often cheaper than an NHS prescription.</p>
</div>
<h2 class="c-accordion__title"><button aria-controls="accordion-accordion-8-collapsible-11" aria-expanded="false" class="c-accordion__toggle">
                     What does sharing medical records with my GP do?
                </button></h2>
<div aria-hidden="true" class="c-accordion__panel" id="accordion-accordion-8-collapsible-11">
<p>This account option determines whether or not our doctors are able to share their notes, or any returned letters or test results, with offline doctors to continue your care.</p>
</div>
</b></b></div><b><b>
</b></b></div><b><b>
</b></b></div><b><b>
</b></b></div></div><b><b>
<div class="hs_cos_wrapper hs_cos_wrapper_widget hs_cos_wrapper_type_module" data-hs-cos-general-type="widget" data-hs-cos-type="module" id="hs_cos_wrapper_widget_1566987132773" style=""><div class="mdc-layout-grid mdc-layout-grid--no-margin-bottom">
<div class="mdc-layout-grid__inner">
<div class="mdc-layout-grid__cell u-text-center">
<p>
<a class="mdc-button mdc-button--raised mdc-button--wide u-mb16@xs u-ml16@xs u-mr16@xs u-ml0@lg" href="https://www.pushdoctor.co.uk/">Book appointment</a>
<a class="mdc-button mdc-button--outlined mdc-button--wide u-mb16@xs u-ml16@xs u-mr16@xs" href="https://www.pushdoctor.co.uk/how-it-works">How it works</a>
</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="hs_cos_wrapper hs_cos_wrapper_widget hs_cos_wrapper_type_module" data-hs-cos-general-type="widget" data-hs-cos-type="module" id="hs_cos_wrapper_widget_1564064456517" style=""><div class="mdc-layout-grid">
<div class="mdc-layout-grid__inner">
<div class="mdc-layout-grid__cell u-text-center">
<h2>About Push Doctor</h2>
</div>
<div class="mdc-layout-grid__cell mdc-layout-grid__cell--span-8-md mdc-layout-grid__cell--start-3-md mdc-layout-grid__cell--span-6-lg mdc-layout-grid__cell--start-1-lg u-text-left">
<p>Push Doctor are the leading light in online consultations, providing video appointments with NHS-trained GPs to patients across the UK, entirely on their terms. Patients can book an appointment online, or through the app, and be seen wherever they feel comfortable, whenever suits them – either through a <a href="https://www.pushdoctor.co.uk/nhs">partnering NHS surgery</a> or <a href="https://www.pushdoctor.co.uk/pricing">privately</a>.</p>
<p>Sign up, pick a day and time that works best for you – even the very same day – then, when it's nearly time for your appointment, open Push Doctor with ID at the ready and wait for your doctor to connect with you. Video consultations are just like face-to-face consultations. Your doctor will still discuss your symptoms with you, they can still look at affected areas with your device's camera, listen out for telltale signs using your microphone, and provide prescriptions, referral letters and fit notes when necessary.</p>
</div>
<div class="mdc-layout-grid__cell mdc-layout-grid__cell--span-8-md mdc-layout-grid__cell--start-3-md mdc-layout-grid__cell--span-6-lg mdc-layout-grid__cell--start-7-lg u-text-left">
<p>Some of the conditions we treat most frequently include <a href="https://www.pushdoctor.co.uk/what-we-treat/mental-health">mental health</a> and <a href="https://www.pushdoctor.co.uk/what-we-treat/skin-conditions">skin conditions</a>, infections, <a href="https://www.pushdoctor.co.uk/what-we-treat/joint-pains-and-aches">joint pain</a> and common complaints like colds, <a href="https://www.pushdoctor.co.uk/what-we-treat/cold-flu-rtis/flu">flu</a>, asthma, <a href="https://www.pushdoctor.co.uk/what-we-treat/cold-flu-rtis/tonsillitis">tonsillitis</a>, sinusitis and <a href="https://www.pushdoctor.co.uk/what-we-treat/digestive-problems/gastroenteritis">gastroenteritis</a> and <a href="https://www.pushdoctor.co.uk/what-we-treat/digestive-problems/irritable-bowel-syndrome">irritable bowel syndrome</a>.</p>
<p>Our service is <a href="https://www.pushdoctor.co.uk/cqc">regulated by the Care Quality Commission</a>, who awarded us the UK's first digital healthcare 'good' rating in our last inspection. Every one of <a href="https://www.pushdoctor.co.uk/meet-our-doctors">our doctors</a> is an NHS' 'Top Performer', registered with the General Medical Council, so you can never be in doubt that you are receiving the best possible care.</p>
<p><strong>This is the future of healthcare, and it's available right now.</strong></p>
</div>
</div>
</div></div></b></b></span><b><b>
</b></b></main><b><b>
